flagged.title: The Sanctity of Life, Abortion and Euthanasia
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that the 24-week threshold was established by the 1967 Abortion Act rather than the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990, teaching the wrong legislation and date for a key specification detail.

mark_affecting.quote: This refers to the 24-week threshold established by the 1967 Abortion Act over in Great Britain.
